PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle gain (hypertrophy)"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Volume" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell bench press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell shoulder press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline dumbbell flye 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable lateral raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          triceps rope pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec stretch 3m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell back squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg extension 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring stretch 3m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Body Pull":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull-up (assisted if needed) 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell bent-over row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated cable row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell biceps curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Body & Core":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          walking lunge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          cable woodchopper 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad stretch 3m

NUTRITION
  PROTEIN 150g plant
  NOTES
    - Use a variety of plant protein sources: tofu, tempeh, seitan, lentils, chickpeas, beans, edamame, quinoa, buckwheat, amaranth, soy milk, pea protein, hemp protein, vegan protein powders.
    - Aim for 4-6 protein-rich meals/snacks per day.
    - Example day: 
        - Breakfast: Tofu scramble with wholegrain toast (25g protein)
        - Snack: Vegan protein shake (25g protein)
        - Lunch: Lentil & quinoa salad with edamame (30g protein)
        - Snack: Roasted chickpeas & soy yogurt (20g protein)
        - Dinner: Tempeh stir-fry with brown rice (30g protein)
        - Evening: Seitan slices or protein bar (20g protein)
    - Supplement with vitamin B12, vitamin D, and omega-3 (algae oil) as needed.
